gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma (WHO-Grade IV Glioma); Recurrent Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma (GBM); Recurrent Glioblastoma IDH Wildtype
Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (based on the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th edition)

candidate_evidence.quote: Dosimetry, Safety, and Efficacy Study of [177Lu]Lu-XT771 in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrence of glioblastoma following prior treatments.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: These scans will quantify the drug's distribution and the radiation dose absorbed by both the tumor lesions and normal organs (such as the kidneys).

role_evidence.quote: All eligible participants with recurrence of glioblastoma will be assigned to this single experimental arm.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational radioligand targeting carbonic anhydrase IX/XII (lutetium-177 labelled)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: designed to specifically target and deliver beta radiation directly to tumor cells that overexpress carbonic anhydrase IX and XII

role_evidence.quote: a leakage test using a \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 tracer (4-6 mCi) will be performed to ensure proper reservoir function and safety

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 PET tracer used for leakage test and CA IX/XII confirmation

role_evidence.quote: to prevent cerebral edema, participants will receive a prophylactic course of oral dexamethasone (4 mg, 3 times daily)

source_quote.quote: confirmed CA IX/CA XII positive by histology

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset). Radioligand is delivered intracavitary via an Ommaya reservoir; coded new_route and device_dependent false because the reservoir is a delivery route rather than a device activating or enabling the drug (judgement call). Tumour PK coded yes on the basis of imaging-based quantification of drug distribution and absorbed dose in the tumour cavity/lesions (matrix is imaging, not tissue sampling); the description also mentions 'pharmacokinetic data'. IDH wildtype appears only in the conditions list and is not an entry requirement beyond WHO 2021 histology, so no IDH row. [68Ga]Ga-XT771 and dexamethasone are not separately registered interventions but every patient receives them per the arm text (R9).
